facts.subject: main/melee/lb/lbtrigf:.sdata2
facts.existing_value: The section is read-only input to all five routines in lbtrigf.c. atan2f reads signed zero, zero, π, and ±π/2 to handle axes and restore the correct quadrant around atanf(y/x). acosf and asinf use zero and one while forming 1-x², and acosf plus lb_sqrtf use 0.5 and 3.0 in three reciprocal-square-root refinement steps. atanf compares magnitudes against 1+√2 and √2-1 and uses π/2 when reconstructing reciprocal-reduced results. No routine writes these values or maintains persistent state through the section.
